body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. Independently, reduce your next incoming melee Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, push the enemy 1 unit.
Gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Spines (upkeep 1): the first time each round an enemy voluntarily moves between two spaces adjacent to you, its movement ends in the destination space.
